ms.report:
✅ Milestone Outputs
Functional prototype for core wallet functionalities on Cardano Preprod
A working prototype of the Janus zk-wallet is now live and accessible via web browser. The application demonstrates a password-based smart wallet fully operational on the Cardano Preprod network. It includes:
・Wallet Creation: Users create an account by choosing a unique username and password. Behind the scenes, a zk-SNARK proof is generated and linked to a smart contract UTxO that holds user funds.
・Send/Receive Transactions: Users can spend UTxOs by generating a valid ZKProof and submitting the transaction via the website. Wallets can also receive ADA by sharing their smart contract address.
・Register & Delegate to Stake Pool: Users register their stake key and delegate to a stake pool of choice or to a DRep (in line with Chang upgrade).
・Withdraw Rewards: Users can withdraw staking rewards using ZKProof-authenticated transactions. Delegation to DRep is required to meet governance conditions for withdrawals.
・Change/Update Password: Password changes are supported through the generation of a new proof and verification key. The user's wallet address is updated accordingly, worth mentioning that after successful update any scheduled or incoming transfers (e.g stake pool delegation rewards) with the old wallet address will be lost.

All of the above actions are executed through transactions built by the frontend app and signed via ZKProofs without using seed phrases or private keys.
In order to create a new account in the app you'll need a Cardano Preprod wallet (Eternl, VESPR or Lace) with enough funds to cover a transaction fee (~0.5ADA) plus NFT UTxO (~2ADA). Also please make sure if using Eternl that the dapp connector (top right corner, you may need to switch to Pro mode to see it) is green (enabled).
If you want to test it with an existing account you can login with the credentials bellow:
Username: Janus-Preprod#01
Password: Supersecret-preprod-01!

ms.report:
✅ Milestone Outputs
Functional zk-wallet deployed on Cardano Mainnet and Preprod
The Janus wallet is now fully deployed and operational on Cardano mainnet and preprod. This release represents the culmination of all prior development phases, transitioning from preprod to a production-ready environment. The application enables users to interact securely with Cardano using password-based authentication through zero-knowledge proofs, eliminating the need for traditional seed phrases.
The deployed wallet supports the following functionalities:
・Wallet Creation: Users can create a password-based wallet linked to an on-chain NFT identity.
・Send/Receive Transactions: Users can perform secure ADA transactions validated via ZKProofs.
・Register & Delegate: Integration with Cardano delegation and governance features allows delegation to a stake pool or DRep.
・Withdraw Rewards: Stake pool rewards can be withdrawn directly from the wallet interface.
・Change/Update Password: Users can securely update their wallet password.

🔗 Mainnet Wallet: https://januswallet.xyz/
🔗 Preprod Wallet: https://preprod.januswallet.xyz/
